g.text: Design class view · Media storage · Strategy + Adapter · as built at f6cd896
+storedContext(options: StoredJobOptions, groupId): { store: MediaStore; scope: MediaScope }
no MediaStore, callers keep the legacy path
Strategy: MediaStore with two concrete stores, chosen once at startup. Adapter: privateTransport() maps AWS SDK commands to PrivateS3Transport.
Hosted dev runs S3 (REWIND_MEDIA_BACKEND=s3). The local object store is not a product environment; only tests use it. Local runs use the disk path.
